en: Vibhaṅga:
Analysis of Dependent Origination (Paṭiccasamuppādavibhaṅga) 1.
The Exposition according to the Discourses (Suttantabhājanīya)

With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises; with consciousness as condition, name-and-form arises; with name-and-form as condition, the six sense bases arise;
with the six sense bases as condition, contact arises; with contact as condition, feeling arises; with feeling as condition, craving arises; with craving as condition, clinging arises;
with clinging as condition, existence arises; with existence as condition, birth arises; with birth as condition, aging and death arise.
Sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair arise.
Such is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.
In this context, what is ignorance?
Ignorance regarding suffering, ignorance regarding the origin of suffering, ignorance regarding the cessation of suffering, and ignorance regarding the practice leading to the cessation of suffering—
this is called "ignorance" (*avijjā*). In this context,
what are the volitional formations conditioned by ignorance?
The formation of merit, the formation of demerit, the formation of the imperturbable, the bodily formation, the verbal formation, and the mental formation.
In this context, what is the formation of merit?
It is wholesome volition pertaining to the sense sphere and the form sphere, consisting of giving, virtue, and meditation.
This is called “the volitional formation of merit.
In this context, what is the volitional formation of demerit?
It is unwholesome volition pertaining to the sense-sphere realm.
This is called "the formation of demerit.
In this context, what is the "formation of the imperturbable"?
It is wholesome volition pertaining to the formless realm.
This is called "the formation of the imperturbable.
In this context, what is the bodily formation?
Volition regarding the body is the bodily formation; volition regarding speech is the verbal formation; volition regarding the mind is the mental formation.
These are called "volitional formations conditioned by ignorance.
In this context, what is "consciousness conditioned by volitional formations"?
Eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness.
This is called “with volitional formations as condition, consciousness.
In that regard, what is “with consciousness as condition, name-and-form”?
There is name; there is form.
In this context, what is name?
The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of mental formations—
this is called "name."
In this context, what is form?
The four great elements and the form derived from the four great elements—
this is called "form."
Thus, this is name and this is form.
This is called "with consciousness as condition, name-and-form.
In that regard, what is "with name-and-form as condition, the six sense bases"?
The eye-base, the ear-base, the nose-base, the tongue-base, the body-base, and the mind-base—
this is called "the six sense bases conditioned by name-and-form.
In this context, what is contact conditioned by the six sense bases?
Eye-contact, ear-contact, nose-contact, tongue-contact, body-contact, and mind-contact—
this is called “contact conditioned by the six sense bases.
In this context, what is feeling conditioned by contact?
Feeling born of eye-contact, feeling born of ear-contact, feeling born of nose-contact, feeling born of tongue-contact, feeling born of body-contact, and feeling born of mind-contact—
this is called "feeling with contact as its condition.
In this context, what is craving with feeling as its condition?
Craving for forms, craving for sounds, craving for odors, craving for tastes, craving for tangibles, and craving for mental phenomena—
this is called "craving conditioned by feeling.
In this context, what is "clinging conditioned by craving"?
Clinging to sensual pleasures, clinging to views, clinging to rules and observances, and clinging to a doctrine of self—
this is called "clinging with craving as its condition.
In this context, what is "existence with clinging as its condition"?
Existence is twofold:
there is kamma-existence and there is rebirth-existence.
Therein, what is kamma-existence?
The formation of merit, the formation of demerit, and the formation of the imperturbable—
this is called "kamma-existence.
Furthermore, all kamma that leads to existence is kamma-existence.
In this context, what is existence by way of rebirth (*upapattibhava*)?

It is existence in the sense-sphere (*kāmabhava*), existence in the fine-material sphere (*rūpabhava*), existence in the immaterial sphere (*arūpabhava*), existence with perception (*saññābhava*), existence without perception (*asaññābhava*), existence with neither-perception-nor-non-perception (*nevasaññānāsaññābhava*), existence with one constituent (*ekavokārabhava*), existence with four constituents (*catuvokārabhava*), and existence with five constituents (*pañcavokārabhava*).
This is called "existence by way of rebirth."
This is called “with clinging as condition, existence.
In this context, what is “with existence as condition, birth”?
It is the birth, the being born, the descent, the manifestation, the appearance of the aggregates, and the acquisition of the sense bases of this or that being in this or that class of beings.
This is called “with existence as condition, birth.
In this context, what is aging-and-death with birth as condition?
There is aging; there is death.
In this context, what is aging? That which,

for various beings in their respective classes of beings, is aging, decrepitude, brokenness, graying of hair, wrinkling of skin, the decline of the life-span, and the maturation of the faculties— this is called "aging."
In this context, what is death?

That which for various beings is the passing away from their respective classes of beings, the falling away, the breaking up, the disappearance, death, dying, the completion of time, the breaking up of the aggregates, the laying down of the body, and the cutting off of the life-faculty— this is called "death."
Thus, this is aging and this is death.
This is called "with birth as condition, aging-and-death.
In this context, what is sorrow?

The sorrow, grieving, and state of being grieved for one who has encountered the loss of relatives, or the loss of wealth, or the loss of health, or the loss of virtue, or the loss of right view; or one who is possessed of some other kind of misfortune, or touched by some other kind of painful condition.
Internal sorrow, internal lamentation, the burning of the mind, mental distress, and the dart of sorrow—
this is called "sorrow.
In this context, what is "lamentation"?
For one who has encountered the loss of relatives, or the loss of wealth, or the loss of health,
or the loss of virtue, or the loss of right view; for one who is possessed of various kinds of misfortune,
or touched by various kinds of painful conditions— there is weeping, lamentation, wailing, and sorrow.
Lamentation, the state of lamenting, the state of wailing, verbal babble, prattle, moaning, the act of moaning, and the state of having moaned—
this is called "lamentation.
In this context, what is suffering?
That which is bodily displeasure, bodily pain, the unpleasant and painful feeling born of body-contact, the unpleasant and painful sensation born of body-contact—
this is called "suffering" (dukkha).
In that regard, what is mental grief (domanassa)?
That which is mental unease, mental suffering, the unpleasant and painful feeling born of mental contact, the unpleasant and painful sensation born of mental contact—
this is called "grief" (*domanassa*).
In this context, what is despair (*upāyāsa*)?
Whether one is touched by the loss of relatives, or touched by the loss of wealth, or touched by the loss of health,
or touched by the loss of virtue, or touched by the loss of right view; or being possessed of some other kind of loss,
or touched by some other kind of painful state— the distress, the despair, the state of being distressed, and the state of being despaired.
This is called "despair.
Thus there is the origination of this entire mass of suffering; thus there is the convergence, the meeting, the coalescence, and the manifestation of this entire mass of suffering.
Therefore it is said: "Thus there is the origination of this entire mass of suffering."
The Exposition of the Discourses (Suttantabhājanīya). 2.
The Exposition of the Abhidhamma (Abhidhammabhājanīya).
2.1. The Tetrad of Conditions (Paccayacatukka).

With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises; with consciousness as condition, name-and-form arises; with name-and-form as condition, the six sense bases arise;
with the six sense bases as condition, contact arises; with contact as condition, feeling arises; with feeling as condition, craving arises; with craving as condition, clinging arises;
with clinging as condition, existence arises; with existence as condition, birth arises; with birth as condition, aging and death arise.
Thus is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises; with consciousness as condition, name-and-form arises; with name-and-form as condition, contact arises;
with contact as condition, feeling arises; with feeling as condition, craving arises; with craving as condition, clinging arises; with clinging as condition...
Existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death.
Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.
With ignorance as condition, volitional formations; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, name-and-form; with name-and-form as condition...
The sixth sense base; conditioned by the sixth sense base arises contact; conditioned by contact arises feeling; conditioned by feeling arises craving;
conditioned by craving arises clinging; conditioned by clinging arises existence; conditioned by existence arises birth; conditioned by birth arise aging and death.
Thus occurs the origination of this entire mass of suffering.

With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises; with consciousness as condition, name-and-form arises; with name-and-form as condition, the six sense bases arise;
with the six sense bases as condition, contact arises; with contact as condition, feeling arises; with feeling as condition, craving arises; with craving as condition, clinging arises;
with clinging as condition, existence arises; with existence as condition, birth arises; with birth as condition, aging and death arise.
Thus occurs the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
This is the Tetrad on Conditions. 2.2.
The Tetrad on Causes.
With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise, having ignorance as their cause; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises, having volitional formations as its cause;
with consciousness as condition, name arises, having consciousness as its cause; with name as condition, the sixth sense base arises, having name as its cause;

with the sixth sense base as condition, contact arises, having the sixth sense base as its cause; with contact as condition, feeling arises, having contact as its cause; with feeling as condition, craving arises.
With feeling as cause, craving arises; with craving as condition, clinging arises—craving being the cause;
with clinging as condition, existence arises; with existence as condition, birth arises; with birth as condition, aging and death arise.
Thus occurs the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise rooted in ignorance; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises rooted in volitional formations;
with consciousness as condition, name arises rooted in consciousness; with name as condition, contact arises rooted in name; with contact as condition, feeling arises rooted in contact;
with feeling as condition, craving arises rooted in feeling; with craving as condition, clinging arises rooted in craving.
With clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death.
Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise, having ignorance as their cause; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises, having volitional formations as its cause; with consciousness as condition...
Name-and-form has consciousness as its cause; conditioned by name-and-form, the sixth sense base has name-and-form as its cause;
conditioned by the sixth sense base, contact has the sixth sense base as its cause; conditioned by contact, feeling has contact as its cause;
conditioned by feeling, craving has feeling as its cause; conditioned by craving, clinging has craving as its cause.
With clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death.
Such is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise, having ignorance as their cause; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises, having volitional formations as its cause; with consciousness as condition...
Name-and-form has consciousness as its cause; conditioned by name-and-form, the six sense bases have name-and-form as their cause;
conditioned by the sixth sense base, contact has the sixth sense base as its cause; conditioned by contact, feeling has contact as its cause;
conditioned by feeling, craving has feeling as its cause; conditioned by craving, clinging has craving as its cause.
With clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death.
Thus there is the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
This is the tetrad of causes.
2.3. The Tetrad of Association:
Conditioned by ignorance, volitional formations are associated with ignorance; conditioned by volitional formations, consciousness is associated with volitional formations;
conditioned by consciousness, mentality is associated with consciousness; conditioned by mentality, the sixth sense base is associated with mentality.
With the sixth sense-base as condition, contact arises associated with the sixth sense-base; with contact as condition, feeling arises associated with contact;
with feeling as condition, craving arises associated with feeling; with craving as condition, clinging arises associated with craving;
with clinging as condition, existence arises; with existence as condition, birth arises; with birth as condition, aging and death arise.
Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.
With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise, associated with ignorance; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises, associated with volitional formations;
with consciousness as condition, name arises, associated with consciousness; with name as condition, contact arises, associated with name; with contact as condition...
Feeling is associated with contact; conditioned by feeling, craving is associated with feeling; conditioned by craving, clinging is associated with craving;
conditioned by clinging, existence arises; conditioned by existence, birth arises; conditioned by birth, aging and death arise.
Such is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.
With ignorance as condition, there is volitional formation associated with ignorance; with volitional formation as condition, there is consciousness associated with volitional formation;

with consciousness as condition, there is name-and-form, wherein the name is associated with consciousness; with name-and-form as condition, there is the sixth sense base associated with name-and-form;
with the sixth sense base as condition, there is contact associated with the sixth sense base; with contact as condition...
Feeling is associated with contact; conditioned by feeling, craving is associated with feeling; conditioned by craving, clinging is associated with craving;
conditioned by clinging, existence arises; conditioned by existence, birth arises; conditioned by birth, aging and death arise.
Thus occurs the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
With ignorance as condition, there is volitional formation associated with ignorance; with volitional formation as condition, there is consciousness associated with volitional formation;

with consciousness as condition, there is name-and-form, wherein the "name" is associated with consciousness; with name-and-form as condition, there are the six sense bases, wherein the sixth base is associated with "name";
with the sixth base as condition, there is contact associated with the sixth base; with contact as condition...
Feeling is associated with contact; conditioned by feeling, craving is associated with feeling; conditioned by craving, clinging is associated with craving;
conditioned by clinging, existence arises; conditioned by existence, birth arises; conditioned by birth, aging and death arise.
Thus occurs the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
The Tetrad of Associated Factors.
2.4. The Tetrad of Mutuality:
Conditioned by ignorance (avijjā) are volitional formations (saṅkhāra); conditioned by volitional formations as well is ignorance.
With volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises; with consciousness as condition, too, volitional formations arise.
With consciousness as condition, name arises; with name as condition, too, consciousness arises.
With name as condition, the sixth sense base arises; with the sixth sense base as condition, too, name arises.
With the sixth base as condition, there is contact; with contact as condition, too, there is the sixth base.
With contact as condition, there is feeling; with feeling as condition, too, there is contact.
With feeling as condition, there is craving; with craving as condition, too, there is feeling.
With craving as condition, there is clinging; with clinging as condition, there is also craving.
With clinging as condition, there is existence; with existence as condition, there is birth; with birth as condition, there is aging and death.
Thus occurs the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise; with volitional formations as condition, too, ignorance arises.
With volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises; with consciousness as condition, too, volitional formations arise.
With consciousness as condition, name arises; with name as condition, too, consciousness arises.
With name as condition, there is contact; with contact as condition, there is also name.
With contact as condition, there is feeling; with feeling as condition, there is also contact.
With feeling as condition, there is craving; with craving as condition, there is also feeling.
With craving as condition, there is clinging; with clinging as condition, there is also craving.
With clinging as condition, there is existence; with existence as condition, there is birth; with birth as condition, there is aging and death.
Thus occurs the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise; with volitional formations as condition, too, ignorance arises.
With volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises; with consciousness as condition, too, volitional formations arise.
With consciousness as condition, name-and-form arises; with name-and-form as condition, too, consciousness arises.
With name-and-form as condition, there is the sixth sense base; with the sixth sense base as condition, there is also name-and-form.
With the sixth sense base as condition, there is contact; with contact as condition, there is also the sixth sense base.
With contact as condition, there is feeling; with feeling as condition, there is also contact.
With feeling as condition, craving arises; with craving as condition, too, feeling arises.
With craving as condition, clinging arises; with clinging as condition, too, craving arises.
With clinging as condition, existence arises; with existence as condition, birth arises; with birth as condition, aging and death arise.
Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.
With ignorance as condition, volitional formations come to be; and with volitional formations as condition, ignorance comes to be.
With volitional formations as condition, consciousness comes to be; and with consciousness as condition, volitional formations come to be.
With consciousness as condition, name-and-form; with name-and-form as condition, also consciousness.
With name-and-form as condition, the six sense bases; with the sixth sense base as condition, also name-and-form.
With the sixth sense base as condition, contact; with contact as condition, also the sixth sense base.
With contact as condition, there is feeling; with feeling as condition, there is also contact.
With feeling as condition, there is craving; with craving as condition, there is also feeling.
With craving as condition, there is clinging; with clinging as condition, there is also craving.
With clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death.
Thus occurs the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
This is the tetrad on mutual conditionality.
2.4.1. Matrix:
Ignorance conditioned by formations …pe… ignorance conditioned by consciousness …pe…
With name as condition, ignorance arises … [and so on] … with the sixth base as condition,
ignorance arises … [and so on] … with contact as condition, ignorance arises … [and so on].
With feeling as condition, ignorance arises; ... pe ...
with craving as condition, ignorance arises; ... pe ...
with clinging as condition, ignorance arises; ... pe ...

With ignorance as condition, volitional formations arise; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness arises; with consciousness as condition, name-and-form arises; with name-and-form as condition, the sixth sense base arises;
with the sixth sense base as condition, contact arises; with contact as condition, feeling arises; with feeling as condition, craving arises; with craving as condition, clinging arises;
with clinging as condition, existence arises; with existence as condition, birth arises; with birth as condition, aging and death arise.
Thus occurs the origin of this entire mass of suffering.
The Matrix.
2.5.1. Unwholesome Consciousness.
Which states are unwholesome?
At whatever time an unwholesome consciousness has arisen, accompanied by joy, associated with wrong view,
having as its object a visible form, or a sound, or a smell, or a taste, or a tangible object—
or mental phenomena as object, or whatever else he has taken as a basis—at that time, with ignorance as condition there is volitional formations;
with volitional formations as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, name; with name as condition, the sixth base; with the sixth base as condition, contact;
with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, craving; with craving as condition, clinging; with clinging as condition...
Existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death.
Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.
In this context, what is ignorance?
That which is ignorance, non-seeing ... [as before] ... the shackle of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called "ignorance.
In this context, what is the volitional formation conditioned by ignorance?
Whatever volition, intention, and state of having intended—
this is called "with ignorance as condition,
formations arise. In this context, what is "with formations as condition, consciousness arises"?
That which is mind, intellect, mentation, heart, lucidity, the mind-base, the mind-faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding element of mind-consciousness—
this is called "consciousness conditioned by formations.
In this context, what is "mentality conditioned by consciousness"?
The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of mental formations—
this is called "name conditioned by consciousness.
In this context, what is the sixth sense base conditioned by name?
That which is mind, intellect, mentation, heart, lucidity, the mind-base, the mind-faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding element of mind-consciousness—
this is called "the sixth base conditioned by name.
In this context, what is contact conditioned by the sixth base?
That which is contact, touching, impingement, the state of being touched—
this is called "contact conditioned by the sixth sense-base.
In this context, what is feeling conditioned by contact?
That mental state which is pleasant, that mental state which is happiness, the pleasant and happy feeling born of mind-contact, the pleasant and happy sensation born of mind-contact—
this is called "feeling with contact as its condition.
In this context, what is craving with feeling as its condition?
Whatever lust, infatuation, inclination, compliance, delight, and lustful delight there is, as well as the infatuation of the mind—
this is called "craving with feeling as its condition.
In this context, what is "clinging with craving as its condition"?
Whatever view there is— view-occurrence, the thicket of views, the wilderness of views, the distortion of views, the vacillation of views, the fetter of views,
grasping, settled grasping, adherence, misapprehension, the wrong path, the false course, falsity, the domain of sectarians, and the distorted grasp— this is called the underlying tendency to views.
This is called “with craving as condition, clinging.
In this context, what is “with clinging as condition, existence”?
With the exception of clinging itself, it is the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness.
This is called “with clinging as condition, existence.
In this context, what is “with existence as condition, birth”?
It is the birth, the arising, the production, the manifestation, the appearance of those various phenomena.
This is called “with existence as condition, birth.
In that regard, what is aging-and-death with birth as condition?
There is aging; there is death.
In this context, what is aging?
That which is the aging, the state of being worn out, the collapse of the life-span of those various phenomena—
this is called "aging."
In this context, what is death?
That which is the destruction, passing away, breaking up, dissolution, impermanence, and disappearance of those various phenomena—
this is called "death."
Thus, this is aging and this is death.
This is called "with birth as condition, aging-and-death.
In this way there is the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
In this way there is the conjunction, the meeting, the convergence, and the manifestation of this entire mass of suffering.
Therefore it is said: "In this way there is the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
At that time, with ignorance as condition there is volitional formations; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, name-and-form.
With name as condition, contact arises; with contact as condition, feeling arises; with feeling as condition, craving arises; with craving as condition, clinging arises;
with clinging as condition, existence arises; with existence as condition, birth arises; with birth as condition, aging and death arise.
Such is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.
Therein, what is ignorance?
That which is lack of knowledge, lack of vision … [as above] … the snare of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—
this is called "ignorance."
In this context, what is the volitional formation conditioned by ignorance?
Whatever volition, intentionality, and state of having intended—
this is called "the volitional formation conditioned by ignorance."
In this context, what is consciousness conditioned by volitional formations?
That which is mind, intellect, mentation … [as before] … the corresponding element of mind-consciousness—
this is called "consciousness conditioned by volitional formations."
In this context, what is "name conditioned by consciousness"?
The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of mental formations—
this is called "name conditioned by consciousness."
"Conditioned by name, there is contact.
In this context, what is name?
With the exception of contact, it is the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness.
This is called "name.
In this context, what is contact conditioned by name?
It is that which is contact, touching, impingement, and the state of having been impinged upon.
This is called "contact conditioned by name.
... [as before] ... Therefore it is said: "Thus is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.
At that time, there is volitional formation conditioned by ignorance; consciousness conditioned by volitional formation; and name-and-form conditioned by consciousness.

With name-and-form as condition, the sixth sense-base arises; with the sixth sense-base as condition, contact arises; with contact as condition, feeling arises; with feeling as condition, craving arises;
with craving as condition, clinging arises; with clinging as condition, existence arises; with existence as condition, birth arises;
with birth as condition, aging and death arise.
Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.
Therein, what is ignorance?
It is that lack of knowledge, lack of vision... [as before] ...the yoke of ignorance, delusion, the root of unwholesomeness.
This is called “ignorance.
In this context, what is the volitional formation conditioned by ignorance?
It is volition, deliberate intention, and the state of having intended.
This is called “with ignorance as condition, volitional formations.
In this context, what is “with volitional formations as condition, consciousness”?
That which is mind, mentation, ideation … [as before] … the corresponding element of mind-consciousness.
This is called “with volitional formations as condition, consciousness.
In that regard, what is “with consciousness as condition, name-and-form”?
There is name; there is form.
In this context, what is name?
The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of mental formations—
this is called "name."
In this context, what is form?
It is the accumulation of the eye-base, the accumulation of the ear-base, the accumulation of the nose-base, the accumulation of the tongue-base, the accumulation of the body-base;
or whatever other form there is that is mind-born, mind-caused, and mind-originated.
This is called "form.
Thus, this is name and this is form.
This is called "name-and-form conditioned by consciousness."
“With name-and-form as condition, the sixth sense-base.
There is name; there is form.
Therein, what is name?
The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of mental formations—
this is called "name.
In this context, what is "form"?
Whatever form depending upon which the mind-consciousness element occurs—
this is called "form.
Thus, there is this name and this form.
This is called "name-and-form.
In this context, what is the sixth sense-base conditioned by name-and-form?
That which is mind, intellect, mentation … [as before] … the corresponding element of mind-consciousness.
This is called “the sixth sense-base conditioned by name-and-form.
In this context, what is contact conditioned by the sixth sense-base?
It is that which is contact, touching, impinging, and the state of having been impinged upon.
This is called "contact with the six sense bases as condition.
... [as before] ... Therefore it is said: "Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.
At that time, with ignorance as condition there is volitional formations; with volitional formations as condition there is consciousness; with consciousness as condition there is name-and-form.

With name-and-form as condition, the six sense bases arise; with the six sense bases as condition, contact arises; with contact as condition, feeling arises; with feeling as condition, craving arises;
with craving as condition, clinging arises; with clinging as condition, existence arises; with existence as condition, birth arises;
with birth as condition, aging and death arise. Thus occurs the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
In this context, what is ignorance?
That which is lack of knowledge, lack of vision … [as before] … the snare of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—
this is called "ignorance."
In this context, what is volitional formation conditioned by ignorance?
That which is volition, purposeful volition, the state of having willed—
this is called "volitional formation conditioned by ignorance."
In this context, what is consciousness conditioned by volitional formations?
That which is mind, intellect, mentation … [as before] … the corresponding element of mind-consciousness—
this is called "consciousness conditioned by volitional formations."
In this context, what is name-and-form conditioned by consciousness?
There is name; there is form.
In this context, what is name?
The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of mental formations—
this is called "name.
In this context, what is "form"?
The accumulation of the eye-base, the accumulation of the ear-base, the accumulation of the nose-base, the accumulation of the tongue-base,
the accumulation of the body-base, or whatever other form there is that is mind-born, caused by the mind, and produced by the mind— this is called "form."
Thus, this is name and this is form.
This is called "with consciousness as condition, name-and-form.
With name-and-form as condition, the six sense bases.
There is name, there is form.
Therein, what is name?
The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of mental formations.
This is called "name.
In this context, what is "form"?
It consists of the four great elements and that form depending upon which the mind-consciousness element occurs.
This is called "form.
Thus, this is name and this is form.
This is called "name-and-form."
In this context, what is the sixfold sense base conditioned by name-and-form?
The eye-base, the ear-base, the nose-base, the tongue-base, the body-base, and the mind-base—

That which is the mind’s resolution, the act of resolving, the state of being resolved upon that—
this is called "resolution conditioned by feeling."
In this context, what is existence conditioned by resolve?
With the exception of resolve itself, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness—
this is called "existence conditioned by resolve."
In this context, what is birth conditioned by becoming?
That which is the birth, the arising, the production, the manifestation, and the appearance of various phenomena—
this is called "birth conditioned by becoming."
In this context, what is aging-and-death conditioned by birth?
There is aging; there is death.
In this context, what is aging?
That which is the aging, the decrepitude of those various phenomena, the collapse of the life-span—
this is called "aging.
In this context, what is "death"?
Whatever is the exhaustion, passing away, breaking up, dissolution, impermanence, and disappearance of those various phenomena—
this is called "death. Thus, this is aging and this is death.
This is called "with birth as condition, aging-and-death.
Thus there is the origination of this entire mass of suffering.
Thus there is the convergence, the meeting, the assembly, and the manifestation of this entire mass of suffering.
